summary: Fill-conditioned n-tuple leaf experiment: seed-free diagnostic of the frozen tables' touched entries by pattern fill; fill-conditioned layouts (occ5, hgt5) and multi-stage weight promotion in the ntuple-scale crate, the trainer's warm start, a depth-3-only screen arm and incremental screen artifacts, new CHECK gates (fill bucket reference, promotion preserves value); the two no-training edits of the frozen tables (zeroed, class-mean); the theory, the preregistered experiment with three fresh leases, and the stage driver; ran the gates, the edits, the three warm-started training arms, the freeze and the one-shot 512-game screen; wrote the analysis, the result record, the approach page section, the web figures and the log entry.
validationPerformed: cargo test --release (14 unit tests, including layout sizes with fill buckets, bucket edges, promotion preserving values bit for bit and separating buckets under one update)
gate binary on the probe block for both fill layouts (gates.log, gates-hgt5.log) and gate --weights on each of the four new table files before the screen lease opened
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.

The owner proposed the direction (an evaluator that switches toward survival as the board fills) and asked for steps 1 and 2 of the model's written plan to be preregistered and run end to end; the model designed the bucket variables, the promotion warm start, the control arm, the two edits, the selection rule and the gate, and ran everything on the same workstation as the three earlier n-tuple experiments.
